title: Don't send commit metadata when BUILDKITE_SKIP_CHECKOUT is set
body:
The ability for the agent to skip checking out the branch/commit was added in https://github.com/buildkite/agent/pull/3672. However, when checkout is skipped, the local git state may not match the build's expected branch/commit (it's likely to be on an old branch/commit).  Sending metadata from this stale state could report incorrect commit information to Buildkite.

Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019d47ef-62a5-759a-b5b8-d985d83cdcbe

Fixes: PS-1696

### Testing
- [x] Tests have run locally (with `go test ./...`). Buildkite employees may check this if the pipeline has run automatically.
- [x] Code is formatted (with `go tool gofumpt -extra -w .`)

<!--
Note: if the tests fail to run locally, please let us know!
-->


### Disclosures / Credits

This change was almost entirely written by AMP (linked above). I had to help it with the test because it's first attempt would always pass (false positive).
